plan.archetype: Efficient attacks into sustained scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Establish scaling early, cross 160 HP promptly, maintain weakness and reliable block; enter healthy with an emergency potion.
plan.summary: Take efficient damage first, then scaling and premium defense. Buy useful cards and potions; add Accelerant only after reliable poison. Fight elites with sufficient health and damage; upgrade cores when safe.

plan.archetype: Efficient attacks, potion generation, scaling damage, and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Acquire sustained damage and stronger block, upgrade key damage while healthy, maintain weakness, and stock useful potions before fighting.
plan.summary: Boss simulation exposes a major shortfall. Prioritize sustained damage and premium defense, use renewable potions proactively, remove Strikes, and avoid elites until the deck improves.
